Name: Maono Mic Mute
Description: Mute and unmute a Maono microphone with a key press — the real mute, with the device LED. Works on its own, or through Maono Link. The key shows whether the microphone is muted.

Actions.Name: Toggle Mute
Actions.Tooltip: Mute or unmute the Maono microphone (the device LED lights); the key shows whether it is muted

Localization.The microphone is not connected, and Mao: The microphone is not connected, and Maono Link is not open.
Localization.This is the real microphone mute — the d: This is the real microphone mute — the device mute LED lights, the same as its own mute button.
Localization.It works on its own; and through Maono L: It works on its own; and through Maono Link when its microphone panel is open.
Localization.Connect your Maono microphone, or open M: Connect your Maono microphone, or open Maono Link, so the key can mute it.
Localization.Could not change the mute of the microph: Could not change the mute of the microphone.
Several Maono microphones are connected. Choose which one this key mutes.
Localization.The microphone chosen for this key is no: The microphone chosen for this key is not connected.
Localization.Maono Link is using the microphone. Open: Maono Link is using the microphone. Open its microphone panel, or quit Maono Link.
